_note: Everything the YouTube uploader says about us, in one place. Edit here, not in upload-youtube.js.
blurb: Get It? gives your class one code. They answer on their phones or in homework - two minutes, no marking. You see exactly who got it, who is shaky, and who is quietly faking it, before the test does.
free: Free for teachers while it is in beta.

playlist.mobile: Get It? - teacher tutorials (on a phone)

hooks.01-what-get-it-is: Thirty students nod. That is not the same as thirty students understanding. This is the two-minute check that tells you the difference.
hooks.02-create-your-account: One teacher account, about a minute. No class list to build and no pupils to add.
hooks.03-set-up-your-class: A class is one code, and it lasts all year. You set it up once.
hooks.03b-put-the-code-on-the-wall: The code goes on the wall, the board or the slide. Pupils type it and they are in.
hooks.03c-the-year-group: The year group tells the marking how much detail to expect. It never changes whether an answer is right.
hooks.04-write-the-questions: You type the topic. Get It? writes the questions, with the marks and the model answers.
hooks.05-how-pupils-join: Two minutes on their phones, or set as homework. Nothing to mark afterwards.
hooks.05b-what-the-pupil-sees: What a pupil actually sees. Worth watching once so you can answer the questions you will get.
hooks.06-read-your-results: One screen: who got it, who is shaky, and who is quietly faking it.
hooks.07-change-a-colour: If the marking gets a colour wrong, you change it yourself. You are still the teacher.
hooks.08-spot-the-pattern: The record builds itself. Spot the class-wide misconception before the test does.
hooks.06b-take-the-record-away: A pupil leaving, or a whole class moving on - take the record with you.
hooks.09-your-data: What Get It? stores, what it does not, and how to get it out. In plain English.
hooks.09b-if-it-gets-it-wrong: If it gets an answer wrong, tell it. Every correction makes the next one better.
